subject: Entitlement Telemetry & SCIM Delta Samples — SOC2 Evidence Intake
messages:
From: Alyssa Kim <security@brightwave.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Entitlement telemetry & SCIM delta samples for SOC2 evidence

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC2 intake we need a short delivery of artifacts that show provisioning cadence and role assignment provenance. Specifically we'd like:

- SCIM delta file(s) for the last 90 days (adds/updates/deletes) scoped to our tenant (brightwave.com)
- Sample SAML assertion logs showing nameID and role attributes for service accounts used to call your API (2-3 examples)
- A CSV of role-to-permission mapping for all production roles with owners identified
- Entitlement telemetry: token/session tags that tie requests to roles and the last 30 days of role activation events

We are okay with redacted account IDs; please include a mapping file that explains what you redacted (e.g., hashed user IDs). Do you have an expected ETA for delivery and a preferred secure transfer method? We can accept an encrypted Drive folder or a pre-signed S3 link.

Thanks,
Alyssa Kim
Security Program Manager
BrightWave Health
security@brightwave.com

[Attachment: example-sig-questions.pdf]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Kim <security@brightwave.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlement telemetry & SCIM delta samples for SOC2 evidence

Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Neha for SCIM and Rishi for entitlement telemetry. Quick notes and plan below: 

- SCIM delta: we can produce a delta export (adds/updates/deletes) for the tenant back 90 days. We'll sanitize PII and include a mapping README. Expect single compressed CSV ~30MB. (action: Neha)
- SAML assertion samples: we will pull assertion snippets (redacted to remove actual NameIDs) for 3 service-account flows.
- Role mapping: attached is a template "authz-playbook.xlsx" we've used for other certs — we'll populate the production roles tab.
- Telemetry: Rishi will extract the role_activation events and session tags; we'll provide a 30-day window and an example row format.

Preferred delivery: encrypted Drive folder (shared with security@brightwave.com). If you prefer S3, let us know and we'll generate pre-signed links.

ETA: preliminary bundle by 2026-05-06 EOD; final redacted package by 2026-05-10 if you need deeper traces. 

Deliverables we will attach: scim-delta-sample.csv, authz-playbook.xlsx, entitlement_telemetry_20260503.zip (redacted).

-Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks — that's helpful. A couple clarification items before you deliver: 

1) For the SCIM delta CSV, can you include the timestamp format and schema in the README (we'll ingest programmatically).
2) For SAML assertions, please strip any email addresses but retain role attribute names and values. 
3) For role-to-permission mapping, can you flag any roles that grant write access to production data stores? We mark those as high risk in our intake. 

We'll plan to review the preliminary bundle on 2026-05-07; please share Drive folder when available.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Alyssa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Kim <security@brightwave.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlement telemetry & SCIM delta samples for SOC2 evidence

Alyssa / Tessa — bundle uploaded to encrypted Drive; sharing link below. Contents summary:

- scim-delta-sample.csv (90-day delta, columns: op,timestamp,externalId,username,groups,source)
- authz-playbook.xlsx (production roles tab populated, owners listed; high-risk roles flagged in column "risk_level")
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (3 redacted assertion snippets showing role attribute names/values)
- entitlement_telemetry_20260503.zip (30-day role_activation events, session tag examples; user identifiers hashed with salt; README explains hash map)

Drive link (encrypted access): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxx-ExampleDriveLink
HubSpot intake ticket: HS-23847

Per your note: timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC in the CSV; role-to-permission rows mark write access in the "perm_write" boolean column. If you need additional columns for ingestion, tell us which fields and we'll include them.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Platform Reliability — Observability
Redwood Inference
